public_rationale: The claim has three parts. Anthropic's February 12, 2026 funding announcement says Claude Code's run-rate revenue had grown to over $2.5 billion, so the ARR part holds. I could not find a primary or reputable source for a realized Claude Code revenue figure of $203m. Reports on Anthropic's later S-1 say it does not break out Claude Code revenue. I also found no documented source showing Anthropic spent $8 to $13.50 to serve Claude Code for each revenue dollar. Nothing I found contradicts those figures, but nothing confirms them either. One part is supported and two cannot be checked, so the claim as a whole is unresolved.
limitations: The speaker gives no source or period for the $203m figure or the cost ratio.
Run-rate figures are company-reported and unaudited.

statement.excerpt: Even Claude Code, the second coming of Christ in the minds of some of Silicon Valley’s most concussed boosters, only made $203m in revenue ($2.5bn ARR) for a product that at times involves Anthropic spending anywhere from $8 to $13.50 for every dollar it makes.
statement.document_title: The AI Bubble Is An Information War

from_speaker: at times involves Anthropic spending anywhere from $8 to $13.50 for every dollar it makes
our_interpretation: The claim has three parts: (a) Claude Code's annualized run-rate (ARR) was about $2.5bn; (b) Claude Code made $203m in revenue; (c) at times Anthropic spent $8 to $13.50 to serve Claude Code for each dollar of revenue it earned.

He gives no period for the $203m. The parenthetical suggests it is roughly one month of revenue matching the $2.5bn run rate. I do not assign it to a specific month. The target period runs from Claude Code's general launch (May 2025) to the post date.
'At times' limits part (c) to some periods or some users, not to the product's average economics. Testing it needs a documented cost-to-revenue ratio for Claude Code.
The claim is supported only if all three parts are shown. A documented figure that clearly conflicts with any part would contradict that part.
criteria.support_condition: Anthropic or credible reporting shows Claude Code ARR of about $2.5bn, a realized Claude Code revenue figure of about $203m, and documented instances where Anthropic's cost to serve Claude Code was $8 to $13.50 per dollar of Claude Code revenue.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Primary or credible reporting shows Claude Code ARR or revenue for the period clearly different from $2.5bn or $203m, or shows Claude Code cost to serve well below $8 per revenue dollar in every period.
